description: Admins, owners and finance. Issues a cancellation for a document, with your reason. The original keeps its number and turns to cancelled. Its payments are open again, so invoices.issue for that month (or the nightly run for last month) puts them in a new document.

id.description: Id or number of the document

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

reason.description: Why, 3 to 500 characters. It is written on the cancellation

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: invoices.cancel
title: Cancel a document
